## Why This Question Is Asked

```yaml
name: Deploy to Azure
on: [push]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: azure/login@v1
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}
      - uses: azure/get-key-vault-secrets@v1
        with:
          keyvault: "mykeyvault"
          secrets: "secret-name"
        id: getSecrets
      - run: echo "${{ steps.getSecrets.outputs.secret-name }}"
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests multi-tenant API design using fundamental Azure primitives.

## Key Concepts
- API Management, Front Door, Private Link, Key Vault, Managed Identities
- JWT tenant scoping, RBAC, quotas, auditing
- Data isolation with tenantId partitioning

## Code Example
```xml
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <validate-jwt header="Authorization" failed validation-httpcode="401" failed validation-error-message="Unauthorized">
      <openid-config url="https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantId}/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration"/>
      <required-claims>
        <claim name="roles"/>
        <claim name="tid"/>
      </required-claims>
    </validate-jwt>
    <set-variable name="tenantId" value="context.Request.headers.GetValueOrEmpty('X-Tenant-Id')"/>
    <quota-control-by-key key="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>('tenantId'))" calls="100" renewal-period="PT1H"/>
  </inbound>
</policies>
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How handle on/offboarding of tenants without downtime?
- How to scale APIM across regions and ensure data residency?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests understanding of basic Azure networking (Private Endpoints), secret management (Key Vault), and identity-based access (Managed Identities) in a simple web API setup.

## Key Concepts

- Private Endpoints for secure, private access to SQL and Key Vault
- Managed Identity usage for serverless authentication to Key Vault
- Secrets retrieval without embedding credentials
- TLS termination and traffic routing with Azure Front Door
- GitHub Actions CI/CD and minimal disaster recovery

## Code Example

```python
from azure.identity import ManagedIdentityCredential
from azure.keyvault.secrets import SecretClient
import pyodbc

credential = ManagedIdentityCredential()
kv_url = "https://<your-keyvault-name>.vault.azure.net"
client = SecretClient(vault_url=kv_url, credential=credential)
secret = client.get_secret("<sql-conn-string-secret>").value
conn = pyodbc.connect(secret)
```
